notablePrerequisites: Bloodchief Ascension has at least three quest counters on it.
description:
Activate Hair-Strung Koto by tapping Famished Paladin, causing an opponent to mill a card.
Bloodchief Ascension triggers, causing the opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
